verdict.rationale: Viam ships an official documented CLI (docs.viam.com/cli/reference) that supports data queries, fleet/machine management, and generic API invocation with JSON in/out, and Viam explicitly documents agentic use of the CLI/SDK by AI agents to drive machines. This is first-party documentation only, without independent hands-on corroboration of agent usage. Missing for 10: independent/community verification of AI-agent CLI usage in practice, and more detail on auth/scripting ergonomics for agentic workflows.
